title: Return types in tkinter.filedialog
author: Akuli
body_preview: If I cancel or close the dialog without selecting anything, I get:  ``` >>> import tkinter.filedialog >>> tkinter.filedialog.askdirectory() () >>>  ```  The stub says that the return type is `str`. We should probably use `str | tuple[()]` to also allow empty tuples. The actual type may also depend on the Tcl/Tk version.  I haven't tried other `tkinter.filedialog` functions.
